destinations.name: Nanjing
destinations.rank_reason: Provincial capital and former imperial capital; Wikivoyage city page with districts, Sun Yat-sen and Ming tombs on guidebook itineraries. China-wide a rank 2 (Hangzhou class), not rank 1 beside Beijing/Shanghai/Xi'an.
destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page 'Nanjing' (See/Do listings); guidebook chapter in Lonely Planet China; city is the name travellers use.
destinations.span_reason: 41 spots within about 21 km of the centre (Pearl Spring, Sifang, Qixia, Yangshan the furthest); 50 km span gives a 37.5 km allowance.
